subject: Next steps: lock in platform walkthrough and host access
messages:
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ian Collins <ian.collins@novacare.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + options to lock the walkthrough

Ian — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from my side:
- Goals: evaluate inference latency/cost tradeoffs for your document ingestion pipeline and discuss private deployment options for PHI-bound data.
- Success signal: we want to show a POC that sustains your 200 qps target at under 120ms p99 and a reproducible cost estimate.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute platform walkthrough + ops Q&A where our Solutions Engineer runs through a focused architecture review and we present a short spike plan. Please pick one of these windows (all PT):
- Thu Jun 3, 10:00–11:00
- Fri Jun 4, 14:00–15:00
- Mon Jun 7, 09:00–10:00

Who from your side should join? We recommend a single technical owner (eng/infra) and a product stakeholder; I’ve cc’d Ben (AE) here to coordinate. If any of those times work, I’ll put a calendar invite on the confirmed slot with a Zoom bridge and a short pre-demo checklist attached.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

—Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

From: Ian Collins <ian.collins@novacare.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@novacare.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + options to lock the walkthrough

Markus — thanks for the summary. Fri Jun 4, 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our schedule.

Attendees from NovaCare: me (engineering lead), Sofia (product), and I will loop in procurement once we get scope/estimate (procurement@novacare.ai).

Two small asks before the call:
1) Can you share your recommended agenda with timeboxes?
2) We may need a short explanation of private deployment networking (VPC peering vs. customer-managed NAT) — can your SE cover that?

If Fri 14:00 is confirmed I’ll lock the slot on our side.

Thanks,
Ian
Ian Collins
Head of Engineering
NovaCare AI
ian.collins@novacare.ai

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ian Collins <ian.collins@novacare.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + options to lock the walkthrough

Perfect — Fri Jun 4, 14:00–15:00 PT is on. Agenda (60m):
- 0–10m: Quick recap & success criteria (Markus)
- 10–35m: Architecture and private deployment patterns (Marissa) — VPC peering, private control plane options, KMS/HSM integration
- 35–50m: Performance profile & cost levers (Ben) — batching, quantization profiles, routing policies
- 50–60m: Next steps / POC scope and ownership (all)

Marissa will lead the infra/networking Q&A you requested. Ben — can you send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and attach the two-page pre-demo checklist (network checklist + sample perf targets)?

Ian — I’ll add procurement to the invite as optional so they have the time.

Thanks — see you Friday.

—Markus

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ian Collins <ian.collins@novacare.ai>, Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@novacare.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@novacare.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Calendar invite + Zoom bridge + pre-demo checklist

Hi all — calendar invite has been sent for: Fri Jun 4, 14:00–15:00 PT
Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Passcode: 314159

Agenda (attached):
- 10m: recap & goals
- 25m: architecture + private deployment patterns (VPC peering, private control plane, KMS options)
- 15m: performance & cost levers (batching/caching, quantization suggestions)
- 10m: next steps / POC scope

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (pdf) — short checklist of access we’ll need and test dataset guidance. Please review the checklist prior to the call and confirm you can provide the sample dataset and a sandbox GCP project or AWS account for the spike.

Ben — FYI I set you as host and gave Markus co-host.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Thanks, Marissa — invite received and I’ve accepted. I’ll bring our product architect (Luis Ortega) to the call as well — adding him to the attendee list.

Procurement (procurement@novacare.ai) will attend optionally; they asked for the rough cost band and license terms, so I’ll flag that for the end of the call.
